title: Rilakkuma Short Anime Gets 3rd Season
content: The new short anime of San-X 's Rilakkuma character ended episode 24 on Saturday with an announcement of the third season, Rilakkuma : Ki Mama ni Manpuku Biyori (Carefree, Well-Fed Days).
author: ANN

title: Ryō Kurashina, Issaku Wake's Jotei Manga Gets New Live-Action TV Series
content: Ryō Kurashina and Issaku Wake 's Jotei Super Queen manga is inspiring a new live-action television series which will premiere in the YTV channel's late-night "Drama DiVE" programming block on October 22.
